Poker-room style football quiz

Enter, take a seat, beat the table.

Register your table name, pick a 2 to 4 seat room, choose your table style, and play a mixed football trivia round. Every question starts at 10 points and every player gets one answer attempt.

Credits are points only in this prototype. No cash buy-in, no cash-out, no official league marks. Bot response time averages about 7 seconds, with a 5-15 second range.
